description: Convert head circumference (cm or inches) to US/UK, EU and Japanese hat sizes using the real fitted-hat size table.

faqs.a: US (and UK) hat sizes equal the head circumference in inches divided by π, rounded to the nearest eighth — e.g. a 22-inch head ÷ π ≈ 7.
faqs.q: How are US hat sizes calculated?

faqs.a: Yes — EU and Japanese sizes are simply the head circumference in centimetres, rounded to the nearest whole cm.
faqs.q: Are EU hat sizes just centimetres?

faqs.a: Measure around your head just above the eyebrows and ears, where the hat will sit. Use a soft tape, snug but not tight.
faqs.q: How do I measure my head?

howto: Pick whether you measured in centimetres or inches.
